title: Build-Readiness Probes — Docs + Spec → 'ready to build this slice?'
description: Probe catalog run by Claude Code before starting build on a slice. A slice is a release_plan milestone name or an explicit list of spec_ids from spec.json (per engineering-spec.schema.json). Probes interrogate the source documents, the spec, their cross-links, and the execution environment, then aggregate into a single verdict. Probes never fix anything — they report; remediation is a separate step.

x-runner-protocol.invocation: Inputs: (1) spec.json, (2) the docs listed in spec.inputs, (3) a slice selector — milestone name or spec_id list. Resolve the slice to its item set PLUS the transitive closure of dependencies whose status is below 'deployed_staging' (the same threshold PRB-021 uses for 'already satisfied'); probes run over that closed set. Log the resolved set first.
execution_order: 1. STRUCTURAL (method: deterministic) — cheap mechanical checks on spec.json shape and cross-references. If any blocker fails here, still run the rest of this tier, then stop and report: judgment probes over a broken structure waste effort.

2. SEMANTIC (method: judgment) — LLM evaluation of content quality against each probe's rubric. Judge each item fresh; do not assume the spec author was right. Quote evidence verbatim for every failure.
3. ENVIRONMENT (method: runtime) — optional live checks (repo, CI, env vars, sandbox credentials). Skip with status 'skipped' if the runner has no environment access, and say so in the report.
honesty_rules: A probe with no evidence either way fails closed for blockers (report 'cannot verify' as fail) and open for warnings (report 'cannot verify' as warning).
Never mark a judgment probe pass because the field is merely non-empty — the rubric is the bar, not presence.
Sample sizes: where a probe says 'spot-check N', pick the N highest-risk instances (money, auth, data deletion, third parties), not random ones.
x-runner-protocol.output: Emit readiness-report.json conforming to $defs.reportSchema, plus a short human summary leading with the verdict. Findings sorted blockers-first.

x-verdict-model.READY: Zero failed blocker probes; warnings allowed and listed.
x-verdict-model.READY_WITH_CONDITIONS: Failed blockers exist but every one has a remediation the runner classifies as 'mechanical' (fixable inside the spec/doc set without a human decision). Listed as preconditions to start.
x-verdict-model.NOT_READY: At least one failed blocker requiring a human decision or missing external prerequisite.
x-verdict-model.note: The verdict applies only to the probed slice, not the whole spec.

probes.name: Input documents present and readable
probes.check: Every doc in spec.inputs (brd + supporting_docs) exists at its stated location and is readable. Compare version_or_date against the file's actual state where detectable (frontmatter, title page, mtime).
probes.pass_criteria: All docs open; no version mismatch.
probes.remediation: Restore or re-link the missing doc; re-run spec generation if a binding doc changed version.

probes.name: BRD extraction completeness
probes.check: Re-scan the BRD independently for requirement-bearing sentences (shall/must/should/needs to/users can, plus tables and bullet features). Diff that inventory against traceability_matrix. The spec author's own extraction must not be trusted as the baseline.
probes.pass_criteria: No requirement-bearing statement in the BRD is absent from the traceability_matrix.
probes.remediation: Add missed requirements as BRD-xxx rows and either cover them with spec_items or move them to out_of_scope with a reason.

probes.name: Binding-document conflict scan
probes.check: Across all docs marked authority: 'binding', find contradictions relevant to the slice (different limits, different flows, different pricing). Check spec.architecture.decision_records / open_questions for a recorded resolution of each.
probes.pass_criteria: No unresolved contradiction touching any slice item.
probes.remediation: Raise an open_question with a proposed resolution; human decides which doc wins.

probes.name: Quote fidelity spot-check
probes.check: Spot-check 5 highest-risk traceability_matrix rows referenced by the slice: does requirement_text faithfully reflect the BRD at source_location, without strengthening, weakening, or inventing numbers?
probes.pass_criteria: All sampled rows faithful.
probes.remediation: Correct the paraphrase and re-check dependent spec_items for drift.

probes.name: Glossary coverage for the slice
probes.check: Collect domain terms used in slice items (business_rules, user_stories, entity names). Each is either in spec.glossary or an everyday word.
probes.pass_criteria: No undefined domain term.
probes.remediation: Add glossary entries; if a term's meaning is genuinely unclear from the docs, escalate to open_questions.

probes.name: Schema validity
probes.check: spec.json validates against engineering-spec.schema.json (required fields, enums, patterns).
probes.pass_criteria: Zero validation errors.
probes.remediation: Fix the spec document; this is always mechanical.

probes.name: Slice resolves cleanly
probes.check: The slice selector matches a real milestone or real spec_ids; every referenced spec_id exists; dependency closure computes without dangling references.
probes.pass_criteria: Resolved item set is non-empty and fully linked.
probes.remediation: Fix milestone spec_ids lists or dependency entries.

probes.name: No TBD / placeholder content in slice items
probes.check: Scan every field of each slice item for 'TBD', 'TODO', 'FIXME', '???', 'placeholder', empty required arrays.
probes.pass_criteria: None found in required fields; occurrences in optional fields downgrade to warning.
probes.remediation: Fill from docs, or convert to an open_question with proposed default.

probes.name: Acceptance criteria are testable
probes.check: Every acceptance_criteria entry: (a) Given/When/Then form, (b) observable outcome, (c) no subjective adjectives (fast, intuitive, robust) without a number, (d) a competent engineer could write the test without asking questions.
probes.pass_criteria: All entries pass all four; per-item failure lists the offending criterion verbatim.
probes.remediation: Rewrite criteria; pull numbers from business_rules or performance_targets.

probes.name: Business rules are quantified
probes.check: Every business_rules entry contains exact values (limits, formulas, thresholds, rounding, currency/timezone handling) — no 'reasonable', 'several', 'appropriate'.
probes.pass_criteria: All rules deterministic enough to unit-test.
probes.remediation: Extract exact values from the BRD; if the BRD only has adjectives, open_question with a proposed number.

probes.name: Flow coverage: errors and alternates
probes.check: For each main_flow step that can fail (network, validation, permission, third party, concurrency), a matching entry exists in error_handling or alternate_flows. For user-facing items, ui_states covers loading/empty/error/denied.
probes.pass_criteria: No uncovered failure point on the happy path.
probes.remediation: Enumerate the missing failure handling before build, or accept as a listed warning.

probes.name: API contract completeness
probes.check: Each endpoint has method, path, auth (with explicit tenant scoping), request_shape, response_shape, non-empty error_codes; mutating endpoints state idempotency.
probes.pass_criteria: All endpoints complete.
probes.remediation: Fill contract gaps; tenant-scoping omissions escalate to PRB-031.

probes.name: Data model completeness
probes.check: Every entity: all fields typed with nullability; tenancy stated; retention stated; relationships resolve to entities defined somewhere in the spec.
probes.pass_criteria: All entities complete and internally consistent.
probes.remediation: Complete the model; unresolved relationships usually mean a missing spec_item.

probes.name: Cross-item contradiction scan
probes.check: Across slice items (plus already-built items they touch): same endpoint specified twice with different shapes; same entity field with different types; conflicting business rules; two items claiming the same feature_flag with different semantics.
probes.pass_criteria: No contradictions.
probes.remediation: Reconcile in the spec, bump versions of changed items, log in change_log.

probes.name: Item sizing sane
probes.check: No slice item has complexity_estimate XL; flag L items whose acceptance_criteria count exceeds ~10 as split candidates.
probes.pass_criteria: No XL items in the slice.
probes.remediation: Split into smaller spec_items with their own acceptance criteria.

probes.name: Forward traceability of the slice
probes.check: Every slice item lists brd_requirement_ids that exist in traceability_matrix, or has a technical item_type with a justification in summary. Reverse direction: every BRD row whose covered_by intersects the slice actually lists those items.
probes.pass_criteria: Bidirectional links intact.
probes.remediation: Repair links; unjustified untraceable items need a reason or removal.

probes.name: Dependency closure buildable
probes.check: Every dependency of every slice item is (a) in the slice, (b) already status ≥ deployed_staging, or (c) an ext: dependency handled by PRB-022. Detect cycles.
probes.pass_criteria: Topological order exists; no unmet internal dependency.
probes.remediation: Pull missing prerequisite items into the slice or re-scope the milestone.

probes.name: External and human prerequisites satisfied
probes.check: Collect all ext:/human dependencies, config_and_secrets marked human-provisioned, and third_party_integrations needing accounts/credentials for slice items. For each, find affirmative evidence of readiness (env var present, sandbox key documented, account confirmed in docs). Absence of evidence = not ready.
probes.pass_criteria: Every external prerequisite has evidence, or an explicit stub/mock plan lets build proceed without it (then warning, not blocker).
probes.remediation: Produce a human checklist of exactly what to provision; this is the most common NOT_READY cause.

probes.name: No blocking open questions touch the slice
probes.check: No open_questions entry with blocking: true and empty resolution whose question_id appears in any slice item's open_question_refs, or whose context field names a slice spec_id.
probes.pass_criteria: Zero unresolved blocking questions on the slice.
probes.remediation: Present the questions with their proposed defaults for one-word human approval.

probes.name: Approval state
probes.check: spec_meta.status is 'approved', and every slice item's status is 'approved' (not draft/deferred). Items with owner claude_with_human_gate are flagged in the report so the gate is scheduled.
probes.pass_criteria: Spec and all slice items approved.
probes.remediation: Route the spec through its approvers; drafts must not enter build.

probes.name: Assumption exposure
probes.check: List every assumptions entry on slice items. Assess each: if wrong, would built work be discarded? High-consequence assumptions without evidence of human review get flagged.
probes.pass_criteria: No high-consequence unreviewed assumption.
probes.remediation: Surface the risky assumptions for explicit confirmation before build.

probes.name: Persona cross-reference
probes.check: Every persona phrase named in a spec_item.user_stories entry appears verbatim as a product_overview.target_users[].persona value. The rule is stated only inside the user_stories description string in engineering-spec.schema.json; JSON Schema cannot express a cross-field constraint, so no validator enforces it and a violation will pass schema validity (PRB-010) cleanly.
probes.pass_criteria: Zero user-story personas absent from target_users.
probes.remediation: Promote the persona into target_users where the story is doing real work as written; otherwise reword the story to name an existing persona. Do not add a persona that no BRD requirement supports — target_users is what licenses user_stories, and padding it inverts the dependency.

probes.name: NFRs concrete for the slice
probes.check: performance_targets, availability_slo, rate_limits_and_quotas on slice items contain numbers or an explicit inheritance statement ('app default: p95 < 400ms') — not adjectives, not blanks on items where load obviously matters (auth, search, list views, webhooks).
probes.pass_criteria: All applicable NFRs quantified or explicitly inherited.
probes.remediation: Set app-wide defaults once in architecture.decision_records and reference them.

probes.name: Security and tenant isolation stated
probes.applies_when: item touches data, auth, or exposes endpoints
probes.check: security_requirements and permissions_model state: authz check location, tenant isolation mechanism consistent with architecture.multi_tenancy_model, input validation posture, and (where PII) privacy_compliance duties. Cross-tenant isolation must appear in integration_tests.
probes.pass_criteria: All data/auth/endpoint items carry explicit, consistent security statements with matching tests planned.
probes.remediation: This is never skippable for SaaS; write the missing statements before build.

probes.name: Reversibility: migrations and rollback
probes.check: migration_steps present and ordered; rollback_plan is specific (not 'redeploy previous release', which is valid only without db_changes); breaking changes use expand-migrate-contract.
probes.pass_criteria: Every schema-touching item is reversible on paper.
probes.remediation: Write the rollback before writing the migration.

probes.name: Test plan executability
probes.check: unit/integration/e2e test lists cover the acceptance_criteria and edge_cases (each AC maps to at least one named test); test_data_requirements are satisfiable with the environments' data_policy; financial/billing math has hand-computable expected values stated.
probes.pass_criteria: QA could start from the spec alone.
probes.remediation: Backfill named test cases; missing hand-computed values for money math upgrade this to blocker.

probes.name: High risks mitigated
probes.check: Every risk_register entry with likelihood or impact 'high' whose related_spec_ids intersect the slice has a non-empty mitigation.
probes.pass_criteria: No unmitigated high risk on the slice.
probes.remediation: Write mitigations or accept the risk explicitly in the report.

probes.name: Environment matrix supports the slice
probes.check: spec.environments defines at least local + one deployed env with deploy_trigger; every config_and_secrets var needed by slice items maps to a defined environment; feature_flag names are unique across the spec.
probes.pass_criteria: No slice item needs an environment or variable the matrix doesn't define.
probes.remediation: Extend the environment matrix or trim the item's needs.

probes.name: Live workspace readiness
probes.check: In the actual workspace: repo exists and is clean or on a work branch; toolchain installs (deps resolve); test runner executes (even with zero tests); CI/deploy config present for the stated hosting; required env vars for local dev present (values not printed). Skip with 'skipped' if no workspace access.
probes.pass_criteria: A build session starting now would not stall on tooling.
probes.remediation: Scaffold/repair the workspace as its own precondition task before the slice.

probes.name: Third-party sandbox reachability
probes.check: For each integration: sandbox/test credentials exist in env config and a harmless authenticated call succeeds (or a documented mock strategy exists). Never call live/production endpoints of payment or messaging providers.
probes.pass_criteria: Every integration is exercisable in a non-production mode.
probes.remediation: Provision sandbox credentials (usually human) or commit to the mock plan in writing.

spec_id.description: Item the finding is anchored to, if item-scoped.

evidence.description: Verbatim quote or concrete observation — never just 'field looks weak'.

blockers_summary.description: One line per failed blocker, sorted by remediation_class.

human_actions.description: The exact checklist a human must complete (approvals, credentials, decisions). Empty when READY.

warnings_accepted_note.description: If build proceeds with warnings, record that acceptance here.
